description: Search contacts by name (default), email, or phone.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from a previous response.

email.description: Treat the query as an email address.

page.description: 1-based page number. Ignored when cursor is set.

phone.description: Treat the query as a phone number (digits-only match, last-10 fallback).

query.description: Search query (a name, an email, or a phone number).
